Weddings & events

Your day, our devotion

From a wedding for 350 to a rooftop birthday for twenty, our banquet team plans every detail with you: the setting, the menu, the dessert table and the welcome.

Guests book The Pharo for weddings, homecomings, engagements, birthdays, get-togethers and corporate functions.

How it works

From first call to last dance

  1. I

    Enquire

  3. III
